title: Ho, Volta — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ho, Volta: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ho is a city in Volta with a population of 150,000. The capital of the Volta Region, a scenic city near the Togo border and the Akosombo Dam. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
